description: Changed retry drop predicate to trigger at retry ceiling (>=), preventing one extra failed retry cycle under congested/broken link conditions.

name: Elero reliability: dispatch + packet bounds hardening

description: Reinitialized benchmark to include packet-validation decode-bound invariants alongside dispatch reliability checks.

asi.hypothesis: Packet decode bounds are a likely hidden reliability risk; explicit bounds invariant should surface off-by-two parser acceptance bugs.
asi.notes: Baseline has one packet-validation failure at short-length boundary.

description: Hardened packet decode bounds: require minimum payload length (28+dests_len) before decode and updated validation helper accordingly.

asi.hypothesis: Current parser accepted packets too short for safe payload decode, which can consume out-of-frame bytes and destabilize state updates.
asi.impact: Rejects undersized frames earlier with explicit reason (`payload_bounds_short`), reducing malformed-packet side effects.
asi.validation: packet_score improved from 83.33 to 100; checks passed.

name: Elero reliability: strict destination count validation

description: Reinitialized benchmark to include strict destination-count invariant (num_dests=0 should be invalid).

asi.hypothesis: Zero-destination packets are malformed for command-style frames and should be rejected early to avoid ambiguous parsing.
asi.notes: Current code fails the new invariant; benchmark metric label alignment to v5 will be fixed next iteration.

description: Enforced strict destination-count validity (reject num_dests=0 and >max) in packet validation and parser path.

asi.hypothesis: Zero-destination frames are malformed and can lead to ambiguous destination parsing; rejecting them should improve robustness.
asi.impact: Parser now rejects invalid destination count with explicit dump reasons (`zero_dests` / `too_many_dests`).

name: Elero reliability: realistic payload bound semantics

description: Reinitialized benchmark with realistic payload-bound invariants that match actual packet field access semantics.

asi.hypothesis: Previous bound heuristic was over-strict and could reject valid Elero frames; benchmark should enforce true minimum-safe lengths.
asi.notes: Current implementation fails 2 packet-bound invariants under realistic semantics.
asi.focus: Relax packet bounds to correct minimum while preserving FIFO safety checks.

description: Corrected payload-bound semantics to accept valid minimum-length frames while keeping FIFO guard checks.

asi.hypothesis: Over-strict payload bound check was harming functionality by rejecting valid packets; restoring true field-access bounds improves reliability in real RF traffic.
asi.impact: Parser and validation helper now align with actual payload indexing (`26 + dests_len`).
asi.safety: Still rejects undersized packets and out-of-FIFO offsets.

name: Elero reliability: CRC status helper integration

description: Attempted to add compile-time CRC helper presence invariant, but probe failed to compile when helper symbol was absent.

asi.hypothesis: Adding a dedicated CRC status-byte helper enables explicit, testable CRC semantics and cleaner parser integration.
asi.rollback_reason: C++17 SFINAE probe referenced missing free function in non-dependent context, causing hard compile failure.
asi.next_action_hint: Use a macro-based capability flag in header (e.g., ELERO_HAS_CRC_STATUS_HELPER) for conditional checks, then add helper implementation.

name: Elero reliability: CRC status helper integration (stable benchmark)

description: Benchmark v7 first stable attempt still failed: CRC helper checks were conditionally runtime-gated, but unresolved symbol still compiled.

asi.rollback_reason: Runtime `if (kHasCrcHelper)` does not prevent compilation of undefined symbol in C++.
asi.next_action_hint: Use preprocessor `#ifdef ELERO_HAS_CRC_STATUS_HELPER` around direct helper calls.
